'''Hutt's Grotto''' was a business at [[Stobar Spaceport/Legends|Stobar Spaceport]] at the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It featured a multi-[[color]]ed sign stating the business' name in [[Huttese (alternative writing system)/Legends|alternative Huttese]], transforming from orange, white and bright green, to pink, white and bluish-green. It . The business was named after the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]],<ref name="Brothers" /> a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]].<ref name="Nal Hutta">{{DB|species|hutt|Hutt}}</ref>
